issues.description: The helper method assembleBookstore has inconsistent parameters across artifacts: the template (commented stub) and the intended usage expect a no-argument signature, but the solution implements assembleBookstore(seed: Double) (an extra Double parameter) while main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. This mismatch will cause confusion and a compile error and prevents students from following the template's expected helper signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the signature across template, problem description, and implementation. Remove the unused seed parameter from the solution: change private static func assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore to private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore so main() can call it as shown. Alternatively (less preferred), update main() and the template to accept and pass a Double seed and document the parameter in the problem statement.

issues.description: The function used to build the example Bookstore is named assembleBookstore in all artifacts but its signature differs between the template/problem hints and the provided solution. The template/commented stub and the implied usage expect assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore (no parameters), while the solution defines assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore. This mismatch creates mapping confusion: students following the template or problem will implement or call assembleBookstore() with no arguments, but the solution's implementation requires a parameter (and the solution's own call site uses no argument), making it unclear which signature is intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function signature consistent across artifacts. Either remove the unused parameter from the solution and define private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore (so it matches the template and calls), or update the template/comment and all call sites to expect private static func assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore and provide a default or explicit argument where assembled. Prefer changing the solution to assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore to align with the template and problem description.
